charts.title: K2-155 b: orbits around K2-155
charts.description: The orbits of K2-155's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-155 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hirano et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..124H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HIRANO_ET_AL__2018): P 6.34365 d

charts.title: K2-155 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-155 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (43, 44, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 17307715, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 208 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 391 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 208 min late; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 130 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
